paragraphs: Quick one, and it's not about the trade deadline. This site has been read in 28 countries outside the United States. I'm one Commanders fan in Charlottesville, Virginia, writing about a 1-4-1 football team, and that still blows my mind every single time I look.
I've never heard from a single one of you. Not once. So here's a hello in your language, as best I can do it. If I got yours wrong, tell me. That counts as writing in.

A few of you, specifically. To our reader in France who gets Hail Mail: bonjour, and thank you. Germany, you keep coming back, and I notice. Panama and India, I see you too. And Switzerland: you were our number one country outside the US for weeks, and then you went quiet. Are you OK? Did we do something? Come back.

Here's the deal. The first reader from outside the US to write in gets a Burgundy Wire sticker, mailed by me, wherever you are. One sentence is plenty: where you are, and how you ended up with this team. If you want the sticker, leave an email on the hello form so I can ask where to send it. Write in any language. I'll figure it out. All I ask in return is a picture of where it ends up.
Eagles on Sunday night, Nov. 1. Wherever you're watching from, and at whatever terrible hour that is for you: Hail.
plug: Write in from wherever you are: say hello here. It comes in your language, and every question is optional.
